decision: A/B reconciled per issue #172, closing out the 2026-09-02 ad hoc rebuild. reconcile_linkage.R run against the through-2017 arm (artifacts/amcb_npi_linkage_panel-midwifery-plus-nursing_years-through-2017.csv, freshly generated via PANEL_YEAR_MAX=2017) and the full 2007-2026 arm (unchanged from the ad hoc rebuild). Transition matrix reconciled cleanly to 22,357 rows: 5,960 newly matched by 2018-2026 candidates, 198 lost their match, net +5,762 (see /tmp/reconcile2.log for the full matrix). cohort_member assigned via R/amcb_cohort_membership.R::is_cohort_member() (COHORT_MEMBERSHIP_TIERS allowlist) and reproduces the ad hoc rebuild's exact count (17,027), confirming the ad hoc numbers were correct -- what was missing was this reconciliation's audit trail, not a data error. Also fixed a latent bug in reconcile_linkage.R: readr's default 1000-row type guess inferred class5_candidate_npi as logical from an all-NA sample and silently coerced 8 real NPI values to NA on read; both read_csv() calls now use guess_max = Inf.
